name: 01_identity_scales_equal_raw
description: With all scales 1.0 the normalizer is the identity: effectiveWeight(dim, raw) == raw, so the resolved order is exactly the raw weighted-sum order. financial spans ~0.01, latency ~5, equal raw MRS weights 1.0 — latency magnitude dominates, so the fast option b leads (the lexicographic-by-latency defect). This pins that a no-op normalizer changes nothing.
